topic: Syncing chart variables and export functionality
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving the synchronization of variables displayed on analytics charts. Currently, variable selection is one-directional (e.g., selecting variables at the top affects the chart but not vice versa), and this issue impacts data export, where only variables selected in the upper section are exported.

It was noted that a listener needs to be attached to the chart to ensure synchronization works in both directions. Additionally, two minor UI/UX issues were discussed:
1. The ability to click on any variable displayed on the graph (not just the top panels) should allow hiding or showing it.
2. A persistent highlighted area (a rhombus) appears when hovering over the chart, which was deemed non-critical but annoying and should be addressed.
decisions: Implement two-way synchronization for variables displayed on charts.
Fix data export to include all visible variables, regardless of where they were selected on the graph.
Add functionality allowing users to click any variable on the chart to toggle its visibility.
action_items: Create a ticket/task for the two-way synchronization and export fix (likely in JCDEC).
Investigate fixing the persistent hover area on the chart.
The speaker will explain the required changes using visual aids tomorrow.
